_说明: 序列帧单帧模板，按 ai-prompt-spec-shihung.md §7.2 使用。init 填母版文件名（放 ComfyUI/input/），只改 pos 里的动作层词，其余逐字不动。
pos: masterpiece, best quality, amazing quality, very aesthetic, chibi, super deformed, 3 heads tall, full body, solo, [动作层], side view, profile, facing right, androgynous young boy, short black hair, bob cut, half-closed eyes, small three-pronged gold crown, vermilion dot on forehead, dark grey long robe, wide sleeves, crossed collar, gold trim, gold sash, two short gold ribbons hanging at waist, bare feet, long trailing robe hem behind, ink wash painting, sumi-e, flat color, thick ink outline, limited palette, black and gold, blank background, empty background, plain cream paper background, no shadow
neg: worst quality, low quality, lowres, jpeg artifacts, blurry, bad anatomy, bad hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, deformed, watermark, multiple views, character sheet, border, frame, cropped, text, chinese text, japanese text, kanji, calligraphy, inscription, lettering, signature, red seal, stamp, 3d, cgi, photorealistic, render, gradient, airbrush, cel shading, oversaturated, realistic proportions, adult, long legs, tall, front view, facing viewer, both eyes visible, shoes, trousers, background scenery, black swirl, extra ribbons

_动作层可选值.idle: idle breathing, slight sway, arms at sides
_动作层可选值.run: running, one leg forward, one leg back, arms swinging, leaning slightly ahead
_动作层可选值.jump: jumping, knees tucked up, arms raised forward
_动作层可选值.fall: falling, arms spread wide, legs apart, robe swept up
_动作层可选值.dash: dashing, leaning far forward, arms swept back, robe trailing behind
_动作层可选值.attack: attacking, one arm swung forward, torso twisted, sleeve flared
_动作层可选值.hurt: hurt, leaning backward, head tilted back, robe thrown forward
_动作层可选值.turn: squashed sideways, compressed body, shifting weight
_动作层可选值.land: landing, knees bent, body compressed, robe settling
_动作层可选值.era_switch: looking up, head raised, robe swaying
